messages:
Avery: Quick game — one-line compliment for the person on your left, go!
Ravi: 'Gets things done' + strong coffee vibes ☕️
June: 'Calm chaos wrangler' — that fits @Ravi so well 😂
Samira: 'Spreadsheet whisperer' — also, brought bagels this morning :bagel: huge win
Harper: Bagel hero noted. 👑 Vote: everything, plain, or sesame? React with :thumbsup: for everything, :heart: for plain, :sparkles: for sesame
Avery: Everything for me please — sesame if forced
Ravi: :thumbsup: (everything)
June: :heart: (plain) — nostalgia pick
Samira: :sparkles: sesame, fight me 
ops-bot: Poll created: "Bagel mood" — 3 options — ends in 30m — https://redwood.tools/poll/1729984321
Harper: Also tiny kudos: @June did a last-minute deploy help yesterday, saved my sanity. :raised_hands:
June: oh stop, team effort. but thanks! :blush:
Samira: Quick follow-up one-liners are back — new rule: must include an emoji. I'll start: 'Problem hush' :zipper_mouth_face:
Avery: 'Deadline whisperer' :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ravi: 'WiFi therapist' :computer:
Harper: 'Snack procurement czar' :tada:
ops-bot: Reminder: Office plants need watering tomorrow (waterbot scheduled) :seedling:
June: I'll water mine and @Harper's. tag me if you want me to check yours too
Samira: Love this. tiny kindnesses & bagels = good day :sun_with_face:
Avery: Agree — closing with a tiny prompt: share a two-word pep line for someone who needs it today
Ravi: You got this
June: Breathe through
Samira: Keep going
Harper: Small wins
Avery: Bring snacks
ops-bot: Thread archived for posterity (and future bagel debates)
